content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To cite an annual report in apa style, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Identify the specific report number or identifier (2 minutes)
Step 2. Locate the official name of the corporation (5 minutes)
Step 3. Verify the publication year on the cover page (3 minutes)
Step 4. Format the final citation in the bibliography (10 minutes)
Step 5. Access the company’s investor relations website (5 minutes)
Step 6. Search for the company’s headquarters location for internal records (8 minutes)
Step 7. Download the PDF version of the annual report (4 minutes)
Step 8. Determine if the report was retrieved from a database (2 minutes)
Step 9. Cross-check the citation against the APA 7th edition manual (15 minutes)
Step 10. Check for a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) (3 minutes)
Step 11. Copy the exact title of the report (4 minutes)
Step 12. Note the page range for specific financial data (10 minutes)
Step 13. Determine if the author is a group or individual (2 minutes)
Step 14. Proofread the in-text citation (5 minutes)
Step 15. Record the publisher name if different from the author (3 minutes)
Step 16. Verify the spelling of the corporate author (2 minutes)
Step 17. Search for the report on the SEC EDGAR database (10 minutes)
Step 18. Open a new document for citation drafting (1 minute)
Step 19. Categorize the report type (e.g., 10-K) (4 minutes)
Step 20. Check for any supplemental appendices (6 minutes)
Step 21. Look up APA rules for group authors (7 minutes)
Step 22. Note the URL of the document (2 minutes)
Step 23. Highlight the specific quote to be used (12 minutes)
Step 24. Confirm the document version (draft vs. final) (5 minutes)
Step 25. Determine if the report is a print version (1 minute)
Step 26. Review the citation for italicization errors (4 minutes)
Step 27. Save a backup copy of the report (1 minute)
Step 28. Confirm the fiscal year vs. calendar year (5 minutes)
Step 29. Check for the city and state of the publisher (4 minutes)
Step 30. Scan the document for the table of contents (3 minutes)
Step 31. Locate the executive summary (6 minutes)
Step 32. Read the "Notes to Financial Statements" section (45 minutes)
Step 33. Identify the primary stakeholders mentioned (15 minutes)
Step 34. Draft the initial reference list entry (8 minutes)
Step 35. Find the auditor's report page (7 minutes)
Step 36. Extract the CEO's letter to shareholders (20 minutes)
Step 37. Confirm the date the report was filed (5 minutes)
Step 38. Search for press releases related to the report (15 minutes)
Step 39. Identify the specific data points to cite (25 minutes)
Step 40. Look for a permanent archive link (10 minutes)
Step 41. Verify the report's formal title on the title page (3 minutes)
Step 42. Turn on the computer and open a web browser (2 minutes)
Step 43. Arrange the citation elements in the correct order (6 minutes)
Step 44. Double-check the URL for link rot (3 minutes)
Step 45. Review the citation for hanging indents (2 minutes)
Step 46. Clear the workspace for focused research (5 minutes)
Step 47. Check for any errata or updates to the report (12 minutes)
Step 48. Open the APA style guide website (1 minute)
Step 49. Check the punctuation between citation elements (4 minutes)
Step 50. Save the final citation to the reference manager (1 minute)
